cleaning.coordinate_convention: source VOC coordinates preserved; validity requires 0 <= xmin < xmax <= width and 0 <= ymin < ymax <= height
cleaning.duplicated_root_rule: parse concatenated annotation documents and deduplicate identical document bytes
cleaning.invalid_box_rule: filter only boxes that are non-finite, non-positive-area, or outside declared image bounds

official_test_isolation: Seed, ratio, cleaning, and train/val assignment were selected without consulting official test statistics, samples, visualizations, or metrics. Test is audited only after the split is frozen.

split.rare_class_policy: For every trainval source label with at least two images, require at least one image in train and val.
